world_news.headline: How getting surf life saving into the Olympics could save lives
world_news.summary: The top seed in this year's Iron Series, who made headlines by helping save a shark attack victim earlier this year at Coogee, says having surf life saving in the Brisbane Olympic Games would help raise the profile of the sport, and as a result, save lives.

world_news.headline: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
world_news.summary: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

world_news.headline: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
world_news.summary: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.

world_news.headline: Iran, Oman discuss temporary shipping lane through Strait of Hormuz
world_news.summary: Omani FM hopes the two countries will 'soon announce' a joint temporary transit corridor through the Strait of Hormuz.

world_news.headline: More than 1,300 people arrested by ICE in Virginia and Maryland
world_news.summary: More than 1,300 people were arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officers in Virginia and Maryland.

world_news.headline: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
world_news.summary: The operation included the arrest of 39 people in South Africa for romance and investment scams.

world_news.headline: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in US state of Pennsylvania
world_news.summary: Experts warn that declining vaccination rates have opened the door for resurgence of disease once largely eradicated.

world_news.headline: Israeli forces block Palestinian American Lou Ridi from walking on his land
world_news.summary: Israeli forces told Palestinian American Lou Ridi he cannot walk on his own land in Qusra, while settlers roam freely.

world_news.headline: India police clash with protesters a month after Gen Z demonstrations
world_news.summary: Police used water cannons and batons as a few thousand protesters broke through security barricades in Bihar's capital.

world_news.headline: Kurdish-led forces in Syria dissolve after merging with army
world_news.summary: Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) commander campaigns for Kurdish language preservation after decade fighting ISIL.
